name: Telemetry Over DNS

authors.name: Operation Coinnectar Crew (HaxNation x FOSS Mumbai 2026)

description:
A Rust crate, dns_telemetry.rs, offers “service discovery + lightweight DNS metrics.” Under the uptime reporting is a covert channel: a crafted DNS reply carrying a marker is parsed into a command and executed.

Find the marker the parser scans for and the public function that both beacons and runs the delivered command. Submit HXN{<dns_payload_marker>_<function_name>} — the marker exactly as written.
hints: Follow the reply parser: it scans for a short fixed window and treats what follows as a task. The function that runs it is the same one that beacons out.
